notes: Fix: every computer now builds exactly the same Hinglish model as the tested one. The Hinglish setup used to install the newest conversion tools, so other computers could end up with a slightly different model; the tool versions and the model version are now fixed (checked: the result is byte-for-byte identical). The system check shows "not the tested build" with a Rebuild button if an older setup made a different one.

Fix: Hinglish on graphics cards with little free memory. Hinglish uses two speech models; when the card is short of memory they now take turns on it instead of overflowing into normal memory, which made it very slow. Same models, same results.
Fix: on slow computers (for example without a usable NVIDIA card) the extra accuracy checks could run twice as long as their time limit. They now stop on time.
Improved: the progress text tells how long the Hinglish pass will take on this computer and how long the extra checks may take at most.
